sections.heading: 1. Purpose and Scope
sections.body: This Maintenance Policy governs maintenance activities on organizational systems for {system_name} at {org_name}. It applies within the system boundary described as {boundary} and protects Controlled Unclassified Information such as {cui_description}.

sections.heading: 2. Performance of System Maintenance

questions.prompt: How is routine and emergency maintenance performed on organizational systems?

sections.body: System maintenance activities are performed and documented in accordance with {maintenance_performance}.

sections.heading: 3. Control of Maintenance Tools, Techniques, Mechanisms, and Personnel

questions.prompt: How are tools used for system maintenance controlled?
How are techniques used for maintenance controlled?

sections.body: Maintenance tools are controlled through {tool_controls}. Maintenance techniques are controlled through {technique_controls}. Maintenance mechanisms are controlled through {mechanism_controls}. Maintenance personnel are controlled through {personnel_controls}.

sections.heading: 4. Off Site Maintenance Equipment Sanitization

questions.prompt: How is equipment sanitized of CUI prior to removal for off site maintenance?

sections.body: Equipment removed from organizational spaces for off site maintenance is sanitized of any Controlled Unclassified Information using {offsite_sanitization}.

sections.heading: 5. Supervision of Maintenance Personnel

questions.prompt: How are maintenance personnel without required access authorization supervised during maintenance activities?

sections.body: Maintenance personnel who lack required access authorization are supervised during all maintenance activities using {uncleared_supervision}.
